declarations.title: generates a versioned 144px WebP thumbnail keyed by the full canonical hash
declarations.reason: Transparent320x200 PNG → actual144px WebP, alpha, full source/output hashes, exact path/version and size. Backfill uses opaque1200px WebP and does not observe alpha preservation or decoded output.

declarations.title: produces a different immutable path when canonical bytes change
declarations.reason: Two JPEG byte buffers differ only at last byte; both decode and must produce different source hashes/paths. Existing rerun uses identical canonical bytes and cannot detect hashing decoded pixels instead of source bytes.

declarations.title: rejects unreadable and animated canonical files
declarations.reason: Both malformed bytes and animated GIF must reject with distinct messages. Backfill inputs all valid still images; no surviving equivalent input.

declarations.title: dry-run accounts for image and no-image rows without writes
declarations.reason: Dry-run has image-bearing plus missing-image rows and verifies zero upload/pointer calls and planned/not-applicable statuses. Apply fixtures cannot prove no writes.

declarations.title: apply creates a missing object and compare-and-set pointer
declarations.reason: Missing-object apply observes actual upload/pointer requests and created status. Reuse/race paths have existing bytes or matching pointer, so cannot replace missing-object write success.

declarations.title: apply reuses a valid stored thumbnail and refuses a source-change race
declarations.reason: Valid stored object plus stale-source update result=false must avoid overwrite and report canonical_source_changed. Full rerun avoids updatePointer entirely; cannot prove refusal on failed CAS.

declarations.title: refuses canonical URLs outside the owned product-images bucket
declarations.reason: External canonical URL must be refused without fetching. Owned URLs elsewhere never reach this trust boundary.

declarations.title: a full rerun reuses the matching object and performs zero writes
declarations.reason: Expected URL already matches and valid stored bytes exist: zero upload/update calls and reused status. Earlier valid-store scenario has null pointer and false CAS, so cannot prove idempotence.

import assert from "node:assert/strict"
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"
import test from "node:test"

const migration = readFileSync(
  new URL("../supabase/migrations/20260815074148_product_image_thumbnails.sql", import.meta.url),
  "utf8",
)

test("adds a nullable versioned thumbnail URL that is cleared with canonical replacement", () => {
  assert.match(migration, /ADD COLUMN thumbnail_image_url text/i)
  assert.ok(migration.includes("thumbnails/search-v[0-9]+/[a-f0-9]{64}\\.webp"))
  assert.match(migration, /OLD\.image_url IS DISTINCT FROM NEW\.image_url/i)
  assert.match(migration, /NEW\.thumbnail_image_url := NULL/i)
  assert.match(migration, /BEFORE UPDATE OF image_url ON public\.products/i)
})

test("wraps product intake approval and validates matching source-hash metadata", () => {
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /RENAME TO product_intake_approve_reviewed_product_before_thumbnail_image/i,
  )
  assert.match(migration, /canonical_image_sha256/i)
  assert.match(migration, /thumbnail_image_url/i)
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /canonical_image_sha256 IS NULL AND v_thumbnail_image_url IS NULL[\s\S]*expected_thumbnail_image_url := NULL/i,
  )
  assert.match(migration, /approved_product_id := \(approval_result->>'product_id'\)::uuid/i)
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /IF v_thumbnail_image_url IS NOT NULL THEN[\s\S]*UPDATE public\.products[\s\S]*thumbnail_image_url/i,
  )
})

test("adds service-role-only v3 search by delegating to v2 and restoring its order", () => {
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public\.personal_plan_search_assessment_products_v3/i,
  )
  assert.match(migration, /personal_plan_search_assessment_products_v2\(/i)
  assert.match(migration, /product\.thumbnail_image_url/i)
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /ORDER BY result\.sort_order NULLS LAST, result\.product_name, result\.product_id/i,
  )
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public\.personal_plan_search_assessment_products_v3[\s\S]*FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated/i,
  )
  assert.match(
    migration,
    /GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public\.personal_plan_search_assessment_products_v3[\s\S]*TO service_role/i,
  )
})

declarations.title: adds service-role-only v3 search by delegating to v2 and restoring its order
declarations.reason: V3 delegates V2, projects thumbnail, restores ordering, revokes public/anon/authenticated and grants service role. Existing persistence fake RPC returns data without executing SQL or permissions; source contract stays.

declarations.title: alphaCoverage: fully transparent canvas is 0
declarations.reason: Transparent10x10 zero-alpha canvas returns0. Real processItem examples both have nonempty subjects and never exercise all-transparent fallback; retain.

declarations.title: alphaCoverage: matches the known opaque fraction of a synthetic square
declarations.reason: Synthetic10x10 opaque square on20x20 canvas establishes exact0.25 density. Process fixtures use80/100 and900/940 dimensions; transferring a different ratio would not preserve original literal contract.

declarations.title: haloScore: a uniformly bright subject has ~0 boundary halo
declarations.reason: C1: Same bright RGB235/230/225, alpha0/255, nonempty boundary and radius5 are already processed by clean high-res keeper; preserve original score<0.02 assertion against actual result.metrics.halo_score without new calls/inputs.

declarations.title: haloScore: a warm dark ring around the boundary scores high
declarations.reason: Warm ring3px around30px square calibrates boundary density>0.5 at radius5. Composed80px square uses6px ring: changing radius to11 could lower narrow-ring score below0.5 while broad-ring remains above0.5. Distinct geometry; retain.

declarations.title: haloScore: a dark but neutral (non-warm) boundary ring does not trigger the heuristic
declarations.reason: Neutral dark40/40/40 ring exercises saturation exclusion with lum<200; clean bright image exercises lum>=200. Removing sat>=6 would false-flag neutral dark and still pass bright/warm tests.

declarations.title: haloScore: empty canvas does not divide by zero
declarations.reason: Transparent8x8 canvas yields boundaryTotal0 and must return0 rather than NaN. No processItem keeper reaches haloScore on empty subjects because alpha admission exits first.

declarations.title: a low-res source with a shadow halo reports BOTH reasons, not just the last one
declarations.reason: Actual processItem low-res100px warm-ring source accumulates low-res and deshadow-skipped reasons, path and flagged status. Direct halo helper cannot detect reason overwrite or process routing.

declarations.title: a clean high-res source is ok with no reason at all
declarations.reason: R keeper C1: Existing actual processItem940px clean PNG produces ok/no reason/alpha_passthrough, now additionally preserves original near-zero score bound.

limits: Full4 tests+3owners+SQL migration+2CLI helpers. Supporting large finalizer/persistence/Sharp files read only relevant callsites/types/codec paths; hashes do not claim complete review. Static-only; no repo writes or execution.
